Case files from

Six documented projects — from order-management systems to inbox overhauls. Tap a file to open it.

FILE 01

Centralizing Order Management for a Multi-Channel Footwear Business

Operations & Systems Optimization
+

The Problem — Orders came in through four different channels — WhatsApp, phone, Facebook Messenger, and SMS — sometimes split across all of them for a single order. Tracking meant jumping between apps and threads, leading to missed requests and mixed-up details.

How I Helped — I built a centralized Google Form as the single order intake point, connected to Google Sheets for automatic collection. Every order — customer details, product, quantity, delivery date, special requests — now flows into one organized system.

ClientFootwear Retail (Confidential)
TypeOrder Management / Automation
FormatGoogle Forms + Sheets
Result4 channels unified into 1 system
FILE 02

Building an End-to-End Order Tracking System

Operations & Systems Optimization
+

The Problem — When customers asked for order updates, the business owner had to check messages, scroll emails, and search multiple spreadsheets to piece together one answer. There was no single source of truth.

How I Helped — I built a Google Sheets tracker that follows each order through 7 defined stages — received, stock checked, confirmation sent, supplier order placed, supplier delivery tracked, shipment sent, receipt confirmed — with notes at each stage.

ClientRetail Business (Confidential)
TypeOrder Tracking / Visibility
FormatGoogle Sheets, Stage-Based
ResultStatus retrieved in under 30 sec
FILE 03

File Management SOP Development

Operations & Systems Optimization
+

The Problem — Files were scattered and hard to locate, causing a massive time drain, lost productivity, version-control chaos, and mental stress.

How I Helped — I documented a clear, repeatable file management process covering naming conventions, folder structure, storage and access, and retention rules — so the system holds up even without direct oversight.

FILE 04

Sales Data Cleanup & Dashboard Build for a Skincare Brand

Data Analysis & Management
+

The Problem — Sales records were scattered and inconsistent, making them difficult to interpret. The business owner couldn't reliably track revenue or spot patterns in their own sales.

How I Helped — I cleaned and structured the raw data, built formulas to calculate total revenue, and turned the dataset into a clear dashboard with visual charts to track sales patterns and surface key insights at a glance.

ClientSkincare Brand
TypeData Cleaning & Dashboard
FormatGoogle Sheets, Formulas + Charts
ResultLookup time reduced ~80%
FILE 05

Gmail Inbox Management System Setup

Administrative Support
+

The Problem — What looked like "just emails" was actually slowing down communication. Without an organized system, important messages were hard to find, and clutter made the inbox feel unmanageable.

How I Helped — I set up color-coded labels, filters to auto-sort incoming messages, and starred priority emails. I cleared clutter, unsubscribed from irrelevant senders, built a follow-up template, designed a signature, and documented the system in an SOP.

ClientCoaching / Consulting Client
TypeEmail & Inbox Management
FormatGmail — Labels, Filters, SOP
Result1,700+ messages sorted
